position.description: Your core conclusion or recommendation, with the key reasons

options.description: The workable options you considered (including the one you recommend); may be empty when you're only assessing someone else's proposal

idea.description: How it works and why it would work; a complex option can be written out in full

critiques.description: Objections to and challenges of the given proposal, the previous round's points or the question itself (whether it's the right question, whether a constraint should change); may be empty if there are none

target.description: Which point this is about: an option, a point, the question itself or a constraint

issue.description: What the problem is and what it's based on

risks.description: Risks to watch whichever option is chosen

open_questions.description: Facts or assumptions to confirm first, and questions for the decision maker

confidence.description: How sure you are of your conclusion
